title: Desloratadine
overview: Desloratadine is used to relieve sneezing, runny nose, and red, itchy, tearing eyes from allergies. It is also used to relieve symptoms of urticaria (hives; red, itchy raised areas of the skin) including itching and rash. Desloratadine is in a class of medications called antihistamines. It works by blocking histamine, a substance in the body that causes allergic symptoms.

sections.Before taking desloratadine,:
tell your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to this drug, any part of this drug, or any other

Your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects.tell your doctor if you have or have ever had kidney or liver disease.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while taking desloratadine, call your doctor.if you have phenylketonuria (PKU, an inherited condition in which a special diet must be followed to prevent mental retardation, damage to your brain that can cause severe intellectual disability), you should know that the orally disintegrating tablets may contain aspartame that forms phenylalanine.
sections.Some side effects can be serious. Call your doctor if you have any unusual problems while taking this medication.If you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor may send a report to the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online (https://www.fda.gov/Safety/MedWatch) or by phone (1-800-332-1088).
